SC-09.reason: The mediator can read an authenticated RunRecord from GET /v1/runs/:runId, but that record does not contain total usage for a multi-round run. packages/runtime/src/loop.ts overwrites lastUsage on every provider round and complete() persists only the final round. Correcting the runtime aggregation is forbidden, while the criterion requires actual-usage settlement for completed runs.
